verdict.rationale: Vercel documents serverless/edge infrastructure aimed at this use case — Fluid compute 'scales concurrency for AI and I/O-heavy workloads' (vercel-docs-19), isolated container/microVM execution (vercel-docs-12, vercel-docs-34), Edge Middleware running before requests complete (vercel-docs-20), and global CDN/ISR (vercel-docs-21, vercel-docs-22) — all implying fast, elastic scaling. However, no evidence states concrete cold-boot latency (e.g. sub-second) or explicit scale figures (tens of thousands of concurrent instances), and no independent benchmark or load-test corroborates these claims. Missing for 10: documented cold-start/boot-time numbers, explicit large-scale concurrency benchmarks, and independent/hands-on verification of scaling under heavy load.
